note: Hebrew ba'avur ha'adam means "on account of humankind"; modern "for man's sake" suggests "for man's benefit."

kjv: for the imagination of man's heart is evil
mine: even though the inclination of the human heart is evil
note: Hebrew ki can be causal ("for") or concessive ("although"); since human evil was the reason for the flood (6:5), the concessive reading makes better sense of God's promise not to repeat it.
